name: flightmode
description: Soft-block WiFi and Bluetooth and keep them blocked across reboot
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Turns WiFi and Bluetooth off with rfkill. Bluetooth persists across reboot. WiFi comes back after reboot unless a cable is connected or persist is unlocked. Stopping or uninstalling the plugin removes the units and releases the radios.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.0.1: No-LAN WiFi is session-only; persist unlock via on-screen challenge; /boot and USB wifi sentinel; hidden /data/flightmode test mode; clean disable when unit symlinks are removed
